name: Harper
title: Harper: free Grammarly alternative
hook: Grammarly charges you twelve bucks a month to fix your writing. This app does it for free.

features.intro: It fixes your mistakes as you type.
features.say: It underlines spelling and grammar errors, and one click fixes them.
It works right in Gmail, Reddit and GitHub, and your writing never leaves your device.
You choose which of its rules to switch on or off.

caption:
Grammarly Pro charges $12/month (billed yearly). Harper fixes your grammar and spelling for free ✍️

✅ Underlines spelling and grammar mistakes, one click to fix
✅ Works in Gmail, Reddit, GitHub and more
✅ Checks run on your device, so your writing stays private
✅ No subscription, no cloud, 100% free

💻 Chrome · Edge · Firefox
ℹ️ English only, and it's a classic grammar checker: no AI rewrites or tone suggestions like Grammarly.

Comment "GRAMMAR" and I'll DM you the link 🔗
